meta_title: Gloss Finish UK | Decorator & Property Services Nottingham
meta_description: Gloss Finish UK offers painting, decorating, plastering, plumbing and property maintenance across Nottingham. One trusted tradesman, exceptional results. Call today.
hero_subhead: From a freshly decorated living room in Arnold to a full property refresh in West Bridgford — one reliable tradesman handles it all.
services_heading: Painting, Decorating & Property Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full property overhaul, every job gets the same careful prep, clean finish, and honest advice.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Clean lines, no roller marks, and a finish that lasts — every room is prepped properly before a drop of paint goes on. From hallways to full-house redecorations, you'll see the difference that careful, unhurried work makes.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Nottingham weather is hard on outside walls. Properly applied masonry paint and thorough surface preparation mean your home looks sharp and stays protected for years, not months.

services.title: Plastering & Skim Finishing
services.desc: Smooth, flat walls that take paint perfectly — whether you need a full replaster after renovation work or a neat skim over tired, cracked surfaces. Walls are left ready to decorate, with no dusty handover.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Pattern matching, lining paper, and luxury vinyls hung straight and bubble-free. A well-hung feature wall transforms a room; badly hung paper ruins it — this is work worth doing right.

services.title: Plumbing & Bathroom Work
services.desc: Tap repairs, radiator swaps, toilet replacements, and bathroom fit-outs handled by the same person who decorates the room afterwards. No need to co-ordinate multiple tradespeople or repaint around someone else's mess.

services.title: General Property Maintenance & Repairs
services.desc: Cracked coving, damaged skirting, draughty doors, or a snag list after a house move — small jobs that drag on for months when you can't find someone reliable. Book once and get a list of jobs cleared in a day.

about_pullquote: I'd rather take a day longer than hand over a finish I'm not proud of.
about_para_1: Gloss Finish UK is run by a sole, hands-on tradesman based in Nottingham NG5, with over fifteen years working across painting, decorating, plastering, and plumbing. Every job is done personally — there are no subcontractors, no strangers in your home, and no one passing the buck when something needs sorting.
about_para_2: Customers come back because the work holds up and the communication is straight. A quote means what it says, the site is left tidy, and if a second trade is needed — plumbing before tiling, plastering before painting — it gets done in the right order by the same person who understands the full job. That's the practical advantage of a genuinely multi-skilled tradesman.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Gloss Finish UK

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs decorated before Christmas — hallway, lounge, and dining room. Turned up when he said he would, kept the dust to a minimum, and the finish on the woodwork is genuinely the best I've seen. Neighbours have already asked for his number.
reviews.author: Rachel T.

reviews.text: Needed plastering done in the bedroom before redecorating and he did both. Saved me finding two different people and the whole thing was done in three days. Walls are perfectly flat and the painting looks brilliant. Really reasonable price too.
reviews.author: Mark S.

reviews.text: Fixed a leaking radiator valve and then painted the bathroom the same week. Handy having someone who can turn their hand to both — I've been let down by tradesmen before so it was a relief to find someone who just gets on with it and does a proper job.
reviews.author: Diane H.
